setSignature(self)

 

Set the signature for the predicate.

Abstract method to be implemented in subclasses. A typical scenario to implement this method is to:

  1. Collect the geo types by calling getType
  2. Call _setSignature to set the signature with the geo types.
Decorators:
  • @typedoc

calcPred(self)

 

Calculate and set the true points for the predicate.

Abstract method to be implemented in subclasses.

A typical scenario to implement this method is to:

  1. Collect the satisfied objects by either iterating the domains of types in the signature or calling the geo algorithms in the submodules of geo_algorithms.
  2. Call _setTrue to set the true points with the collected objects.

toLCFTable(self, table_id)

 

Translate geo predicate to LCF table. Each "match" becomes a row in the table. The table is created using the LCFTableAPI in iLock by adding the rows to the table given by table_id.

Parameters:
  • table_id (string) - The table type id, as defined in the Types.lcf file.
Returns: Table
Return the built table.
